products.name: deploy-arch-ibm-ai-agent-code-engine
products.label: Demo: Custom IaC for Agentic AI
products.short_description: Provisions the Loan Risk AI Agents sample application on IBM Cloud Code Engine using a serverless architecture
products.long_description:
Configures a serverless IBM Cloud Code Engine project to deploy the Loan Risk AI Agents sample application designed as a proof of concept (PoC) for adopting agentic AI in enterprise workflows.

The application showcases a bank loan processing workflow in the financial industry, demonstrating how LLMs can drive reasoning and actions—moving beyond traditional rule-based approaches. It uses IBM Cloud services including watsonx.ai for inferencing and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and watsonx Assistant/Orchestrate for conversational interactions.

features.title: Automated provisioning with Terraform
features.description: Uses Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision all required IBM Cloud resources, including [Code Engine](https://www.ibm.com/products/code-engine), [Container Registry](https://www.ibm.com/products/container-registry), and associated configurations—ensuring consistency and repeatability.

features.title: End-to-end deployment of Loan Risk AI Agents
features.description: Deploys a complete [agentic AI sample application](https://github.com/IBM/ai-agent-for-loan-risk) that demonstrates LLM-based decision-making for loan processing workflows using watsonx.ai and watsonx Assistant.

features.title: Secure API key and secret management
features.description: Creates [Code Engine secrets](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/codeengine?topic=codeengine-secret) to securely store sensitive information such as IBM Cloud API keys and registry credentials, used during the container build and deployment process.

features.title: Source-to-image build pipeline
features.description: Builds container images directly from source code using Code Engine’s integrated build feature, and pushes the image to IBM Cloud Container Registry.

features.description: Ideal for users looking to quickly deploy the Loan Risk AI Agents sample application using IBM Cloud Code Engine's fully managed, serverless platform—eliminating the need to configure infrastructure or container orchestration.
Automates end-to-end deployment using Terraform modules, including project setup, secrets, builds, and AI integration—enabling repeatable, scalable infrastructure provisioning for agentic workflows.
Demonstrates a complete agentic AI workflow for loan risk analysis using watsonx.ai and watsonx Assistant, highlighting RAG, orchestration, and LLM-based decision-making in financial services.
Includes pre-set defaults for regions, services, secrets, and container builds—minimizing setup time and ensuring a secure, production-aligned configuration.
